title: iPhone: the chat's "Chat history unavailable" and "not saved" lines, and the stored "Not saved" marker on a reply, as on the web
evidence: Filed 2026-11-26 with US-15 AC76 (web). The web shows "Chat history unavailable" after a failed History read, "This reply was not saved to your chat history." by a reply the history file did not take, and "Not saved: you opened another conversation before this reply arrived." by a stored reply marked notSaved left (ChatFileMessage in packages/health-core/src/chat-history.ts; recordExchange in chat-session.ts takes notSaved). The iPhone draws none of the three; its chat view reads stored turns through the engine door (ios/engine/app-doors.ts), which passes the field on but the Swift view does not draw it. Waits for the iPhone chat work after App Store review.
